headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Hyderabad Bathukamma celebrations conclude at Tank Bund.
Youth tries to run over police to evade checking in Attapur, arrested.
Union Minister H.D. Kumaraswamy has sought SIT probe into alleged sting video.
Trump endorses Netanyahu in Israeli election.
Keralam CM offers prayers at Sabarimala, reviews pilgrimage preparations.
bullets_ur: Tank Bund par Hyderabad ki Bathukamma taqreebat ikhtitam-pazeer ho gayeen.
Attapur mein checking se bachnay ke liye police par gaari charhanay ki koshish, nojawan giraftaar.
Markazi Wazir H.D. Kumaraswamy ne mubayyana sting video ki SIT tehqeeqat ka mutaliba kar diya.
Trump ne Israeli intikhabat mein Netanyahu ki himayat kar di.
Keralam CM ne Sabarimala mein prarthana ki, yatra ke intezamat ka jaiza liya.
